mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xnet_mlops_xaa_workflow_execution (uid, workflow_id, status, inputs_json, outputs_json, error_message, started_at, finished_at, elapsed_time, triggered_by, trigger_type, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{uid}, #{workflowId}, #{status}, #{inputsJson}, #{outputsJson}, #{errorMessage}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{elapsedTime}, #{triggeredBy}, #{triggerType}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM xnet_mlops_xaa_workflow_execution WHERE workflow_id = #{workflowId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM xnet_mlops_xaa_workflow_execution WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM xnet_mlops_xaa_workflow_execution WHERE status IN ('scheduled', 'running', 'paused') ORDER BY created_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE xnet_mlops_xaa_workflow_execution SET status = #{status}, inputs_json = #{inputsJson}, outputs_json = #{outputsJson}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, started_at = #{startedAt}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, elapsed_time = #{elapsedTime}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE xnet_mlops_xaa_workflow_execution SET status = #{status}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
